# dsh-app-restart
Adds a **Restart application** section to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app Settings, with a guarded
button that restarts the whole application — the Electron shell, the hosted Web GUI, and the cordis
estarts the whole application — the Electron shell, the hosted Web GUI, and the cordis Host process.
English | 中文
## What it does
- Settings gains a new section ("Restart App") listing what the restart will do and whether the envi

ronment supports it.
- The button is two-step (click, then confirm) to prevent accidental restarts.

- Restart = **graceful quit + automatic relaunch**:
1. a detached relauncher waits for the app main

process to exit, then reopens the app bundle;
2. the plugin triggers the platform's normal quit path
— on macOS the Quit Apple Event, which the shell treats exactly like Cmd+Q, including its active-ta

sk confirmation dialog;
3. if the user cancels that dialog, the relauncher times out and its final `
open` merely focuses the running app — a harmless no-op.
The Electron shell offers plugins no restart IPC (`app.relaunch()` is main-process only), so the res
tart is orchestrated at the OS level from the Host process. No DSH source modifications are needed.
The navigation icon is registered into the shell’s own `settings.section.icon` slot (DSH 0.2.2+), ke
yed by the same section id — no label markup, stylesheet override, or DOM probing. On older shells t
hat predate that slot the section still works and simply keeps the shell’s fallback gear.

## Routes
| Route | Method | Purpose |

| `api/dsh-app-restart/status` | GET | availability facts for the button |
| `api/dsh-app-restart/re
start` | POST | perform the restart |
Both sit behind a loopback-only trust fence (loopback socket **and** loopback Host header, same-orig
in markers enforced). Paired remote devices are deliberately rejected: only the machine's own GUI ma
d). Paired remote devices are deliberately rejected: only the machine's own GUI may restart the app.
## Configuration
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | set `false` to mount nothing |
| `dryRun` | `false` | `POST /restart` answers
with the computed plan and spawns nothing — for verification |
## Platform support
| Platform | Quit via | Relaunch via | Status |
| macOS | Quit Apple Event (bundle id, then app name) | `open <bundle>` after the main PID exits | p

rimary target |
| Windows | `taskkill /PID` (graceful WM_CLOSE) | PowerShell `Start-Process` after t
he PID exits | best effort; if the app cannot be closed gracefully the relauncher still reopens it a

fter the next manual quit |
| Linux | `SIGTERM` | `nohup <exe>` after the PID exits | best effort |
The plugin refuses to run against a development Electron checkout (no `app.asar` beside the executab
le, or the generic `com.github.Electron` bundle id) — a stray relaunch of the generic Electron binar
y would not boot DSH anyway.
## Development
The client half (`lib/client.js`) is a hand-written `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle — the same shap
e tsdown emits for official client plugins — so no build step is required; edit and reinstall.
